justification: Both surfaces carry shallow low-relief curvilinear designs with rounded, groove-outlined forms including circular or ring-like elements, which gives a broadly comparable schematic relief convention. However, A depicts a coherent anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders, torso, arms and a clearly placed disc on the chest arranged in a vertical body scheme, while B shows a sprawling, non-hierarchical field of ambiguous curved and looped shapes with no discernible figure or body-centred arrangement.
